# RUNTIME DEPENDENCY BUDGET — Fifth Final

Generated apps receive only dependencies required by ExportIR/capabilities.

## Never generated by default
- Puck editor.
- Rete editor/history.
- Studio Debug tools.
- Studio workspace/appearance management packages.

## Conditional
- `rete-engine`: only when JS runtime executes ActionGraphs.
- Refine Core: only when generated app contains admin/CRUD runtime.
- Refine Native Expo Router integration: only Native admin and only when compatible.
- TanStack Table: Web data-table runtime only when used.
- TanStack Query: data/provider/cache runtime when used; already part of Refine admin.
- RHF/Zod: forms/admin edit flows requiring them.
- Tiptap editor: only if generated application edits rich text.
- Tiptap Static Renderer utilities: read-only rich text output where required; choose the smallest target-specific package.
- Zustand: only when StateDefinitions/features require shared runtime state.
- Expo modules: only capabilities actually used.
- NativeWind: Native renderer only.
- Capacitor: Capacitor target only.

## Export gate
Before package.json/composer/plugin generation:
1. traverse ExportIR;
2. generate RuntimeDependencyManifest;
3. map each dependency to a capability/feature reason;
4. fail on Studio-only dependency leakage;
5. run install/typecheck/build fixture;
6. save dependency report in evidence.

## Auxiliary conditional UI engines
- Lucide target package: only icons actually imported/tree-shaken.
- Apache ECharts: only Web/server-client outputs using Chart.
- Victory Native: only Native outputs using Chart and compatible stack.
- FullCalendar Standard: only outputs using Calendar.
- react-native-calendars: only Native outputs using Calendar.
- dnd-kit: only Web outputs using Kanban drag interaction.
